messages:
sri: Heads-up — prepping a tabletop for onprem tenant floorplan isolation next Tue. Need quick signoff on RBAC delta, audit streaming path for airgapped deployments, and KMS wrapping/rotation runbook. Who can join?

kevin: I can. drop the RBAC diff pls?

sri: TL;DR: introduce a scoped role `onprem-service-role` (no S3), remove cluster-admin from deployer group, restrict admin ops to jumpbox bastion only. Snippet:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: onprem-service-role
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
```

maria: Quick question — audit logs for private deployments: do we stream off-host or keep local-only with on-demand export? current pattern is filebeat on jumpbox buffering. proposal: relay via mTLS tunnel to central collector (relay host in customer infra) and mirror to local immutable storage for compliance.

ops_jordan: KMS: airgapped HSM + wrapping key flow still the plan? Need exact steps for key rotation without downtime. We should document unwrap->rewrap flow for existing secrets and fallback if HSM not reachable.

cleo: For incident response, add a pre-rotation freeze window: set read-only flag on model-serving pods, revoke temporary service creds, and trigger an allowlisted egress-only mode to prevent data exfil. Also add a checklist to the playbook with comms templates.

sec-bot: Automated scan: found 1 medium CVE in `cgroup_hosting` (CVE-2024-XXXX). Patch scheduled 2024-05-21. See https://intra.redwood/security/scan/3209991234 (reaction :eyes:)

kevin: If we change RBAC we must run the governance test suite: `./scripts/rbac-smoke.sh` against a replay cluster. Also add a quick `kubectl auth can-i` matrix for critical service accounts.

maria: I'll run the smoke tests in dev-sandbox today and post results. Also recommend Cilium NetworkPolicy to enforce tenant isolation and proxy-only egress. Example rule (L3/L4):
```
apiVersion: "cilium.io/v2"
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-isolate
spec:
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      tenant: "blue"
  ingress:
  - fromEndpoints:
    - matchLabels:
        app: proxy
```

ops_jordan: For KMS rotation runbook draft: step 1) create new wrapping key on HSM (label `rot-<ts>`), 2) update key-encryption config, 3) rewrap secrets via agent on jumpbox, 4) monitor unwrap errors, 5) revoke old key after 24h. I'll push a PR.

cleo: IR playbook additions: add automated alert for failed unwrap (>5% errors), step to flip traffic to read-only, contact list for customer oncall, regulatory notice templates, and postmortem tags.

sri: Action items: 1) kevin - open RBAC PR with `rbac-smoke` CI hook; 2) maria - run smoke + post audit-relay design; 3) ops_jordan - KMS rotation runbook PR; 4) cleo - IR playbook + comms snippets. Tabletop Tue 11:00am in conf-room 3 / Zoom. Please ack here.

kevin: ack

maria: ack, running tests now

ops_jordan: ack, drafting runbook

cleo: ack, will add comms templates

sri: thanks all — I'll assemble agenda and send invite. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
